request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation only. Exact asset path; no new automated requests or bulk transfer authorized.

response_contract.format: CSV point reports and surrounding cell characteristics
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Zenodo API license cc-by-4.0. Bounded original GET on 2026-11-25 https://zenodo.org/records/10672225/files/StormInteractions_HAIL.csv?download=1 yielded 48878 bytes, SHA-256 1f5d061ddee6e721bbf356ede3358dcb667f0cc0fba64991a0df3ff1440cc696 and MD5 2fc284273a32085b35fb0b3d2c4e60a2 matching provider. CSV parsed 331 data rows; observed Date, Time, Radar, Lat, Lon, Mag, SM, Sample, Mode1-4, Orientation, neighboring Cell1-5 at 00/10/20/30 minute offsets and blank spacer columns. Selected >=3 inch hail reports, not representative occurrence sample; do not infer annual rates, treat blank headers explicitly, confirm magnitude units and date/time convention from authors. No original data in Git or database; third-party report lineage and scientific independence require review.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Review provider terms and explicit request/byte budget before any future execution.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Freeze exact asset/version, UTC retrieval, size and SHA-256; mutable metadata is not data identity.

rights_and_policy.notes: CC BY 4.0 deposit; original 331-row CSV and MD5 verified. Review report lineage, magnitude/time definitions and exact reuse scope; priority open source for extreme hail validation, not frequency.
